about_the_game:
Most file sharing application require to store your data on their server in order to send a file to its destination. Why is everyone ok with this?

Share-o-matic is a file sharing application that allows you to send or receive files to/from any of your Steam friends also running Share-o-matic, directly.

It is privacy focused: your data is encrypted and is sent directly to the recipient in fast, safe and private way. Reclaim your privacy today with Share-o-matic!

Privacy Focused

Share-o-matic is built with privacy in mind. Nobody can see what you're sending and your files are never stored on any server.  A technical description on how we achieve this, is available on our official website (link available in the sidebar)

End-to-end Encrypted

Your files are encrypted before they're sent, and they're decrypted at destination using E2EE.

No port Configuration Needed
Share-o-matic uses the hole punching technique so you don't have to open any port or configure your computer or router at all. Share-o-matic does all the work, and if your network is heavily filtered, a (slower) fallback is also available (provided that Steam works too!)

Free to use!

Share-o-matic is free to use up to 50MB per file. If you like and would like to support us, need to send larger files, or would like many additional features, consider purchasing the Share-o-matic Turbo DLC which allows you to send any file to your Steam friends!

More to come!

Make sure to read our 'Early Access' section: there's many more features to come!
